Chapter 6791: Save It

Chapter 6791: Save It

“This sin of mine, it was my fault alone.” The old man said sentimentally.

“So your price is atonement.” Li Qiye said.

“Precisely.” He said.

“This is far more difficult than severing your karma.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I know.” He smiled bitterly: “I often think that crossing the shore no longer matters. I just wish to see that beautiful world again.”

“When you see it again, the karma will be easily dealt with just like reaching the shore.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, once atoned, the karma will disappear. Only you can do it.” He said.

“You are an immortal, you can also do it.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, but I won’t be able to nullify the karma due to my old age. It will only accelerate my death, that is fine, but this world will never appear again.” He said: “That’s why I lived a borrowed life to wait for your help.”

“Doesn’t that make me the fool who has to carry your sin?” Li Qiye smiled wryly.

“Others could only dream about being this fool but lacked the ability. Only a few could make it this far but did they have the courage?” He said.

“A debt must be repaid. I will not refuse your request.” Li Qiye said.

“I know, this is why I waited.” He said.

“Then I should thank you for having so much trust in me.” Li Qiye said.

“Curse if you feel like cursing since I did take advantage of you.” He smiled.

“You definitely made a huge profit but I wouldn’t say I was the sucker. Ming Ren and the others couldn’t have come this far without the massive resources allocated from Origination Enterprise. Plus, your gain was due to your vision. Others refused the same deal.” Li Qiye said.

“When I saw you, I knew this little bastard could make it far and shock immortals. It sounded ridiculous then.” He said.

“I suppose I found the right person too, only you could have parted with that many resources without hesitation.” Li Qiye said.

“It was my best deal.” He said: “I had another good one but it didn’t play out.”

“Which one?” Li Qiye asked.

“I wanted your boy to inherit my legacy and enterprise. Unfortunately, he refused and started his own, somehow outcompeting me.” He said with a smile.

“He’s only doing it for fun and won’t stick to it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Regardless, your boy is special and gifted at anything he does. He could have taken Origination Enterprise to a greater height. I thought that even if you didn’t come back to pay, or rather, if I didn't live long enough to wait for your return, I was fine with your son accepting the deal. Honestly, I like him way more than I do you.” He said.

“I wouldn’t be so sure, he might have taken it to a greater peak or squandered it all away.” Li Qiye said.

“I wouldn’t mind because I wouldn’t live to see that day. Once I’m dead, does it really matter?” He said.

“You’re living well and will continue to do so in the future. Don’t worry, the brat will close his store soon enough, your Origination Enterprise will stand strong.” Li Qiye said.

“What a shame, he has so much talent, just no one direction.” He became emotional.

“His path has no direction, only where the dao heart is.” Li Qiye said.

“I actually disagree.” He shook his head.

“Oh?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Because of you, he would always be overshadowed regardless of what he does. If I were in his shoes, I would also choose to do whatever I want. No amount of struggling will surpass you, so why bother?” He said.

“Anyone who ends up with a son like you is cursed.” Li Qiye said.

“Anyone who has a father like you is cursed.” He retorted.

“True, the brat did say something like this.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“To take it further, anyone who is related to you is cursed.” He added.

“You seem fine.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose I will be after you complete the atonement.” He said.

“I don’t have a choice.” Li Qiye smiled wryly and gazed into the distance.

“When do we start?” He became impatient.

“Look at you, it’s not like I can wait but I have time anyway.” Li Qiye said.

“Great, I’ll await your good news.” He relaxed in his chair.

“How do you want me to do it?” Li Qiye asked.

“Save it.” He said.

“That’s not easy.” Li Qiye said.

“Not easy for anyone, you’re one exception.” He said confidently.

“Golden Mortal World, it’s a shame I never had the chance to see its former appearance.” Li Qiye said.

“I only want you to save it, restoring it to its former glory is too much to ask.” He said.

“It has no semblance of the mortal world any longer. It has fallen into darkness, nearly devoured in its entirety.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, it wouldn’t be unreasonable to call it completely broken. Its essence can’t compare to a minor realm.” He sighed.

Among the nine major worlds, two have fallen. One was Stygian and the other Ruin.

Ruin was the result of Heaven Pit Battle. One side turned this world into the most incredible ambush meant for the high heaven. Unfortunately, they were defeated and this world was destroyed.

The fallen combatants included Heavenfall, Dusk, Zhao Dachui...
